description: The Union-Organizing Process flowchart: Generate interest in union among employees -> Collect signed authorization cards (if less than 30 percent sign, process ends) -> Petition NLRB to hold election -> Secret ballot election is held (if union rejected by majority vote, process ends) -> Union signs up members and elects officers -> Collective bargaining over first labor contract -> Labor contract signed -> Grievance procedure used to resolve disputes during life of contract
